collection.title: Audi A3 Cabrio 2008 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a 2008 to 2013 version of the Audi A3 Cabrio which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
